My own enumeration (grep -noE over the whole file for 6-63 char hex runs) surfaces both truncated tokens; the Round-7 extension's remediation method (testing hex tokens against `git cat-file`) only catches tokens that resolve as git commit objects and could not have caught this content-hash truncation, and Round-7's text does not name or correct either value. Downstream failure mode: a task/implementation reviewer cannot verify from this record alone that design.md's/tasks.md's current fingerprints are what the amendment commit produced, so the human-approved amendment exception -- the sole mechanism suppressing this gate's default phase-sequencing failure -- is not fully testable per the calibration's own evidence bar. The calibration ties any hash-abbreviation defect here directly to reinstating the default Critical 'unsafe or unauthorized workflow-boundary' treatment, with no benefit of the doubt.
